text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Trainer-kun. I have made up my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I plan to run in this outfit for the 
upcoming exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next week, she was scheduled to run in an 
exhibition race. But her outfit was—
choice_data_list: So you're going with that outfit, then.
So you're going with that outfit, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, they said we could wear whatever we 
wanted, so this time I'd like to face it 
in Yabusame attire."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The motif of that racing outfit of mine 
isn't who I am right now, but my ideal 
self.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As an "Emperor" in both name and reality. 
You could say this outfit is a sort of 
pledge, showing I have the achievements 
befitting one who leads everyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet the current me... No, precisely 
because I am aiming for the pinnacle as I 
am now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to race in an outfit that lays bare 
the primal instincts of us Umamusume—the 
essence of the yabusame "hunt".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I want to ignite a fire in my heart.
choice_data_list: ...And what do you plan to hunt?
...And what do you plan to hunt?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I want to ignite a fire in my heart.
choice_data_list: ...And what do you plan to hunt?
...And what do you plan to hunt?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The one who sets limits is always 
one's rational self, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"When competing at the pinnacle, there 
will come a time to discard all that and 
race on pure instinct alone."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It might seem wild, brutish, and harsh to 
call it an ideal, but—

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Emcee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the Yabusame! Draw. 
Ready—............Begin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ORAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—If you're facing a matchless monster, 
you'd better have at least that much 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Succumbing to helplessness would hardly be 
fitting for the "Emperor," after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RATTLE-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon me. Hm, that outfit is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Rudolf. —Shall we devour each other 
once more?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel every hair on my body stand on end. 
Narita Brian's sharp gaze locks onto her, 
as if ready to swallow her whole—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well now, what a hearty appetite. Are you 
hungry already?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Hold on, though. If you're going to 
clash, it should be on the racetrack, not 
here. Right?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A message from Air Groove. She says, 
"Regarding tomorrow's meeting, 
preparations are complete."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... Well, I've passed along the 
message. Sheesh... waking me up right in 
the middle of a nap...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you for the message. ...Oh, 
they're already gone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... But it seems both she and I have 
been swept up in the passion of our 
outfits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Your mouth's hanging wide open. Save 
that surprise for the real thing, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Should the opportunity arise to show you 
as well, I shall perform it with all my 
soul.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The true ability of the archer when facing 
a monster— —Symboli Rudolf's true 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the run she delivered in 
that outfit was said to have whipped the 
entire crowd into a frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Naturally, the summit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
On the path to the summit, there are 
countless targets I must hit. Trying to 
shoot through them all might be reckless.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if they laugh at me for punching 
above my weight, I will keep piercing 
every target and climb higher and higher.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And once you draw near the peak. The one 
waiting there—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I'll hunt it down with these legs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, to check how comfortable the 
outfit was to run in, I accompanied her to 
the training course.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew... ...Mm.
choice_data_list: Want to run one more lap?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. True, just one more lap.
Heeey...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Rudolf. Are you free by any chance?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Then how about a little match?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh... hahaha. Yeah, you're right, CB.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us stand side by side on the same 
line. Shall I escort you to the track as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Those eyes of yours. They're 
burning with passion, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, to receive such praise from you. 
Fufu... I'm honored.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the race between the two began—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two dashed out onto the track. It 
carried a fiery intensity far beyond what 
one could merely call practice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That run was, without a doubt, something 
that shook the soul.
